edits.before: Bubble threats begin: the lane's longest stun re-prices their every step-up.
edits.after: Hitting 2 first: E-buffed autos plus Bubble punish his no-escape step-up.

edits.before: Full kit: E the carry's autos and the buffed trade window out-damages their plan.
edits.after: At 3 his Q slow-split and E knockup out-range your auto-empowered trades.

edits.before: Tide the margins: bounce the trades, bubble the answers, and bank the tempo passive.
edits.after: His poke now stacks research toward the execute faster than your heals refill.

edits.before: Tidal Wave online — engages arrive on a wave and disengages leave on one.
edits.after: His full R combo outranges Tidal Wave and can execute your ADC via stacks.

edits.before: First item: the bounce chunks and the bubble converts every gank.
edits.after: First item: his poke DPS now beats your heal-sustain throughput.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption: matchup-defining — The knockup starts the true-damage rotation — dodge it and the research stalls. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep Q Aqua Prison banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Vel'Koz E (Tectonic Disruption): 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s CD — the knockup starts the true-damage rotation, so dodging it stalls the whole research combo and buys your duo the trade window. - His R is 100/90/80s — a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: W the bounce through carry-and-support, E your carry, auto — the trade healed you, billed them, and buffed the follow-up.
edits.after: Tectonic Disruption's knockup has a tight radius — sidestep behind casters and it whiffs, denying his true-damage combo.

edits.before: Throwing the bubble at poke range out of boredom — the stun is the matchup; the rest is salad.
edits.after: Warding into his 810-range E invites the knockup that starts his research combo — ward from max range.
